summary: Creates six-sided box geometry as POP data. It can share the 8 corner points across faces or create 24 unique face points, supports quads, triangles, point primitives, rounded corners, normals, texture coordinates, colors, anchors, and post transforms.

key_params.name: surftype
key_params.note: Connectivity primitive type: none, points, triangles, or quads

key_params.name: uniquepoints
key_params.note: Creates separate points per face instead of shared corner points

key_params.name: modifybounds
key_params.note: Use connected input POP bounds as the starting box bounds

key_params.name: cornerradius
key_params.note: Radius used when rounded corners are enabled

key_params.name: anchoru
key_params.note: Anchor the left, middle, or right side at X=0

key_params.name: anchorv
key_params.note: Anchor the bottom, middle, or top side at Y=0

key_params.name: anchorw
key_params.note: Anchor the back, middle, or front side at Z=0

key_params.name: normal
key_params.note: Creates no normals, point normals, vertex normals, or primitive normals

key_params.name: texture
key_params.note: Creates texture coordinate attributes on points or vertices

key_params.name: texmethod
key_params.note: Controls face, box, and cube-map style texture coordinate placement

key_params.name: color
key_params.note: Create test color attributes on points, vertices, or primitives

common_gotchas: Shared 8-point boxes need vertex or primitive normals for a faceted cube look; point normals smooth the corners.
Unique Points helps per-face attributes but changes topology and point counts, so downstream index assumptions must be updated.
Rounded corners increase subdivision density; budget GPU memory before feeding the result into line, proximity, or ray stages.
